deviations_from_adr: form-record-persister.ts: ADR §2.5 named this as 'соразмерность' escape-hatch scope ('минимум обязан уйти approval:"soglasovanie" и TEL_APPLICATION_SLUG как единственный путь') rather than a full data-driven form→registry mapping table (no existing config source keys on formId 'purchase'/'approval'; inventing one would be a new schema surface disproportionate to this task). Implemented the minimum: both literals are now config-primitive functions (resolveApprovalFormRegistrySlug/resolveTelApplicationSlug, env CHOROS_DEFAULT_STEP_RESULT_SLUG/CHOROS_TEL_APPLICATION_SLUG) rather than a bare const/map entry — an operator can override without a code change, satisfying 'не единственный путь' literally.

flowable-client.ts getActiveUserTasks: NOT named in the spec/ADR as a file to touch, but empirically required for BUG-015 to function on live infra at all. Flowable 7.1.0's GET /runtime/tasks LIST/query REST endpoint does NOT embed candidateGroups/involvedPeople inline in its response items (confirmed against a live flowable/flowable-rest:7.1.0 container) — only GET /runtime/tasks/{id}/identitylinks returns them ([{type:'candidate',group:'<slug>',user:null}]). Without this fix, the FF-2 live-DB test failed (role always fell back to the default, even for a GENERIC process with distinct candidateGroups) — proving the primitive genuinely worked required fixing this pre-existing infrastructure gap, not just the call sites named in the ADR. Added a best-effort per-task identity-links fetch (parallel, non-blocking, degrades to empty candidateGroups on failure — never fails the whole call).

Confirmed by directly curling a live flowable/flowable-rest:7.1.0 container's identitylinks endpoint. Fixed in src/core/flowable-client.ts's getActiveUserTasks (best-effort per-task identity-links fetch, parallel, degrades to empty on failure).

FE-2: process-start.ts's on_create-adjacent skip-submit logic auto-completes WHATEVER user-task is first active after start (by design, for the ТЭЛ-shaped task-submit-is-always-first assumption) — the FF-2 test's minimal generic BPMN (start→gateway-target-task directly) had its OWN target task silently auto-completed before it could be observed. Fixed by adding an explicit task-submit node ahead of the observed task in the test BPMN, matching the real production on_create shape (any authored on_create process has a submit-then-decide shape) rather than changing production code (the auto-complete behavior is correct/intentional, unrelated to this task).

Resolved with vi.mock('node:crypto', importOriginal) overriding only randomUUID, falling through to the real implementation for every call except the one explicitly forced.
